name: plugin.rea_javascript
description: REA JavaScript & Web reverse engineering: Wakaru ^1.13.0 bundle deobfuscation, Electron ASAR archive inspection, passive CDP observation, .NET managed assembly inspection, and offline HAR capture analysis.

entrypoints.name: rea_javascript_recover_sources
entrypoints.description: Recover module directory trees and source maps from minified/bundled scripts via Wakaru ^1.13.0.

parameters.name: bundle_path
parameters.description: Path to bundled or minified JavaScript file

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory to write recovered source modules

parameters.name: sourcemap_path
parameters.description: Optional path to separate source map file

entrypoints.name: rea_javascript_electron_inspect
entrypoints.description: Inspect Electron ASAR archives: manifest, processes, preload scripts, and declared IPC event channels.

parameters.name: asar_path
parameters.description: Path to Electron ASAR archive file

parameters.name: extract_ipc
parameters.description: Whether to analyze scripts for IPC channel declarations

entrypoints.name: rea_javascript_web_observe
entrypoints.description: Passive Chrome DevTools Protocol observation of page DOM structure, loaded scripts, event listeners, and network activity.

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: Optional specific target/page ID to observe

entrypoints.name: rea_javascript_dotnet_inspect
entrypoints.description: Open a managed .NET PE/CLI image: inventory type hierarchies, CIL hashes, and P/Invoke declarations.

parameters.name: assembly_path
parameters.description: Path to .NET managed PE assembly (DLL or EXE)

parameters.name: include_cil
parameters.description: Whether to compute CIL instruction hashes

entrypoints.name: rea_javascript_har_inspect
entrypoints.description: Inspect offline HAR 1.2 or native mitmproxy capture records without contacting recorded servers.
